purpose: Teach: 歌唱/夏季/航行/美的/現世/国防総省/パルス/生産物

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員合唱大会の歌唱を支援しろ
lines.en: I want you to support the company choir competition this season.
lines.style: Crisp, measured command. Direct eye contact. Weight on the verb. No softening—this is a directive, not a request. Pause after 'company'.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。夏季限定商品の販売を強化します
lines.en: Yes. I'll strengthen our summer product line sales.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Slight nod energy in the voice. Professional tempo, not rushed. Specific commitment—he's not just accepting, he's already planning the next step.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海上輸送の航行ルートを最適化しろ
lines.en: Optimize our maritime shipping routes. Make it happen.
lines.style: Steady, expectant tone. Shorter phrasing. Command cadence without harshness. The pause before 'make it happen' carries quiet confidence in his authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製品の美的デザインを刷新します
lines.en: Understood. I'll also refresh our product aesthetics and design approach.
lines.style: Quick, efficient response. Slight upward tick on 'also'—showing he's absorbed and already expanding the scope. Professional but not stiff. Moving forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、現世だけでなく次世代も意識した経営をしろ
lines.en: Our company needs to think beyond the present. We must consider the next generation in everything we do.
lines.style: Slower tempo. Weightier. Philosophical but not abstract—he's being deliberate about the stakes. Slight breath after the first sentence. Conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。国防総省との取引にも参入を検討します
lines.en: Understood. I'll also explore partnerships with the Department of Defense.
lines.style: Quick uptake, no hesitation. The word 'also' lands with energy—he's tracking the expanding scope. Professional clip. Ready to move.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、需要のパルス的変動を分析しろ
lines.en: Analyze the pulse patterns in demand. Understand our market swings.
lines.style: Analytical precision. Slow enough to land weight on 'pulse'—he's being poetic and exact at once. Expectation of rigor in the voice. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地元生産物を積極的に取り扱います
lines.en: Understood. I'll prioritize sourcing from local producers.
lines.style: Clean, conclusive. Finality in the tone—he's summing up and confirming. Steady pace. 'Local producers' lands with slight emphasis. This is the commitment he's walking away with.
